meta.description: Synthetic evaluation corpus: Hindi + Hinglish + Marathi + Telugu + Telenglish sentences with marked critical entities (amounts, quantities, names, dates, products).
meta.note: tts_text uses spoken-form number words so TTS output is controlled. ref is the expected verbatim transcript in the stt_lang's script. entities[].value is the canonical form that must appear in the canonicalized hypothesis. 'teleng' entries are Latin-script Telugu-English (TTS via te-IN Telugu voice, STT scored with en-IN -> Latin output).
